notes.quote: (a) It was pleasing to see that many students were able to score all 3 marks in this part of the question.
The common error seen here was to use 𝑃𝑃(𝑋𝑋 ⩽ 7) − 𝑃𝑃(𝑋𝑋 ⩽ 5).
(b) A range of marks was awarded for this part of the question but there were marks that were accessible to all students.
The majority of students were able to identify N(56, …) so scored M1 and many of these went on to identify N(56, 33.6).
A few however wrote or used N(56, 56).
Many students were able to standardize = z value and so scored M1.
Only a few students used z values outside the range given in the mark scheme.
Those students that used a continuity correction usually went on to score full marks, however too many students failed to realise that a continuity correction was needed.
Many used ± 1.98, but a few students used ±1.96. A common incorrect answer was 68 which came from using 1.98 instead of –1.98 in the standardisation.
